note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Same 42 mm 100 Jahre case as Z7680MB2: case, lugs, crown and pushers from its trace (this photo is taken from the left). Heights as Z7680MB2 (listing 11 mm here; kept for the shared case). Dial, flange, telemeter ring, sub-dials and date come from one photo map of the straightened photo. Bracelet as photographed: a solid end piece between the lugs, then Milanese mesh with a photo map tiled along it.

case.note: (r, z): brushed case flank and the low band outside the bezel (20.1-21 mm in the photo) that carries the crown and pushers

bezel.note: (r, z): polished sloped bezel ring (19.35-20.1 mm); inner lip covers the dial edge

bracelet.mesh_note: metallic photo map: the steel reflects the scene like the case, the photo gives the weave and its dark gaps
bracelet.end_note: solid end piece across the bracelet from under the case to the lug tips (brushed, polished edges); mesh from the lug tips to end_y, photo map repeated every mesh_repeat_mm
bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl (house, from SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R

hand_white.note: white chronograph needle and sub-dial hands as photographed

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission; black base colour so the black dial is not hazed in model-viewer

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines along the bracelet; bevels keep the polished material
